Does NOT have a ['concept_biological_ship', Biological] Shipset

entries.zh: 必须拥有['concept_biological_ship', 生物]舰船组

—生物舰船使用特有的、职责分明的战舰分级，并有三个生长阶段。$NEW_LINE$—建造主要花费$i_food$而非$i_alloys$$NEW_LINE$—维护主要花费$i_food$维护费而非$i_energy$$NEW_LINE$由§Y£society£生物学§!科技主导而非§Y£engineering£宇航技术§!科技。$NEW_LINE$$h_line$§L大量活生生的肌肉纤维构成了活体的舰船，其中充满的生物发光细胞器可以释放高能化合物产生光热爆进行推进。§!
entries.en: - Biological ships use specialized combat ship classes with clearly defined roles and three growth stages. $NEW_LINE$- Construction costs primarily use $i_food$ instead of $i_alloys$ $NEW_LINE$- Upkeep costs primarily use $i_food$ upkeep instead of $i_energy$. $NEW_LINE$- Depend on §Y£society£Biology§! technologies instead of §Y£engineering£Voidcraft§! technologies. $NEW_LINE$$h_line$§LLiving vessels composed of massive, undulating muscle fibers filled with bioluminescent organelles release energy-rich compounds to produce bursts of light and heat for propulsion.§!

entries.zh: §H舰船组类型：['concept_biological_ship',生物]§!\n这些活体战舰天生就是顶级捕食者。它们半感性的躯体以永不满足的意志进行适应、狩猎和攻击。
entries.en: §HShipset Type: ['concept_biological_ship', Biological]§!\nBorn as much as built, these living warships embody apex predation. Their semi-sentient biomass adapts, hunts, and strikes with insatiable will.

entries.zh: §H舰船组类型：['concept_biological_ship',生物]§!\n为勇敢者而生，这些硬壳的星际舰船并不是在服役——它们生存着，与居住其中的无畏探险家们一同成长。
entries.en: §HShipset Type: ['concept_biological_ship', Biological]§!\nBred for the bold, these hard-shelled starships do not serve - they endure, growing alongside the fearless explorers that call them home.

entries.zh: 这些为险恶的深空考验而生的舰船顽强又果决。它们怀着创造者的希望和梦想征服未知，直抵最遥远的繁星。
entries.en: Sturdy and resolute, these vessels are built to endure the trials of deep space. Designed to conquer the unknown, they carry the hopes and dreams of their creators to the farthest stars.

entries.zh: 这些设计体现了不懈思维所蕴含的纯粹性。盘绕的散热结构能够分散来自超频主机的高能输出，确保完美运行，从而追求绝对的效率。
entries.en: These designs reflect the purity of tireless minds. Heat-coiled hulls disperse energy from overclocked mainframes, ensuring flawless operation in the pursuit of absolute efficiency.

entries.zh: 这些坚固的舰船经久耐用，体现了其制造者的坚韧精神。厚重的船体提供隔热与保护，冗余系统确保在最恶劣条件下也能生存。
entries.en: Built to last, these formidable vessels echo their makers' endurance. Dense hulls insulate and protect, while redundant systems ensure survival in the harshest conditions.

entries.zh: 方正实用，这种粗犷的设计让人联想到掠食者的坚韧。它们在虚空中的存在，证明了其创造者冷血般的顽强。
entries.en: Boxy and utilitarian, this rugged design evokes the resilience of a predator. Their presence in the void is a testament to the cold-blooded tenacity of their makers.

entries.zh: 优雅而流畅，这些多功能的飞行器体现了飞行的美感。每一处曲线和轮廓都诉说着一个将太空视为天空延伸而非障碍的物种。
entries.en: Graceful and sleek, these versatile vessels embody the beauty of flight. Every curve and contour speaks of a species that views space not as an obstacle, but as an extension of the sky.

entries.zh: 几丁质或钢铁，形式或功能——并无区别。这些舰船建造的目的不在于激励，而在于持久，其层叠的船体是纯粹生存哲学的明证。
entries.en: Chitin or steel, form or function - there is no distinction. These ships are built less to inspire than to endure, their layered hulls a testament to a philosophy of pure survival.

entries.zh: 优雅而坚固，这些载体既是庇护所，也是利矛。在坚硬的外壳下，复杂的系统以静谧的效率调节着能量流动和养分循环。
entries.en: Graceful yet durable, these vessels are both shelter and spear. Beneath hardened shells, complex systems regulate power flow and nutrient cycles with quiet efficiency.

entries.zh: 这些球茎状的船只唤起了真菌绽放的美丽。它们为自给自足而设计，内部的专门系统形成了复杂的网络，与菌丝的逻辑相呼应。
entries.en: These bulbous vessels evoke the beauty of fungal blooms. Built for self-sufficiency, specialized systems form intricate internal networks, mirroring the logic of the mycelium.

entries.zh: 这些翠绿的飞船不仅穿梭于星际之间，更在星辰中扎根。光合作用的舱体维持着平衡，调节着船内的生态系统。
entries.en: These verdant vessels do not merely travel the stars - they take root among them. Photosynthetic nacelles maintain equilibrium, balancing shipboard biomes.

entries.zh: 历经时间与压力的锤炼，这些岩石般的容器体现了永恒。硅晶体矩阵支撑着核心系统，从塑造大自然的力量中汲取力量。
entries.en: Forged by time and pressure, these rocklike vessels embody permanence. Silicon-crystal matrices buttress core systems, drawing strength from the same forces that shape worlds.

entries.zh: 黑暗而阴森，这些漂浮的大教堂是死亡与重生的纪念碑。它们那充满熵力的核心与仪式化的设计，低语着虚空之力与永恒的野心。
entries.en: Dark and foreboding, these floating cathedrals are monuments to death and rebirth. Their entropic cores and ritualistic designs whisper of voidborne power and eternal ambition.

entries.zh: 庞大而威严，这些设计令人臣服。强化的上层结构和冗余系统展现出无与伦比的统治力。
entries.en: Massive and overbearing, these designs command submission. Reinforced superstructures and redundant systems project an aura of peerless dominion.

entries.zh: 这些船只兼顾流线型和坚固耐受力，汇聚着海洋的力量。水性的内部构造与流线型的外形，体现了其创造者的优雅。
entries.en: Flowing yet turgid, these ships channel oceanic power. Aqueous interiors and hydrodynamic contours embody the grace of their creators.

entries.zh: 这些船只漏着废气，发出不祥的嘎嘎声，无视一切规章制度——但它们还能运行。以废物为燃料，靠着顽固的创造力连接在一起，它们在其他船只失效的地方能够坚持存活。
entries.en: These vessels leak fumes, rattle ominously, and defy every regulation - but they run. Fueled by waste and held together by stubborn ingenuity, they endure where others fail.

entries.zh: 镀铬闪耀，电路嗡鸣，反射神经已成过往。直接神经连接意味着零延迟，无限制——唯有纯粹、高辛烷值的精准。
entries.en: Chrome gleams, circuits hum, and reflexes are a thing of the past. Direct neural uplinks mean no lag, no limits - just pure, high-octane precision.

entries.zh: $mauler_class_plural_cap$是最基础的军用生物舰船，装有短射程武器和厚重大的甲壳装甲。
entries.en: $mauler_class_plural_cap$ are the most basic biological military ship, armed with close range weapons and thick carapace armor.

entries.zh: $weaver_class_plural_cap$是为舰队支援进行特化的改良生物舰船。它们极具适应性，既能助友舰一臂之力，也能干扰敌阵。
entries.en: $weaver_class_plural_cap$ are improved biological ships that specialize in fleet support. They are menacingly adaptive, and can run interference on the enemy while lending strength to allied vessels.

entries.zh: $harbinger_class_plural_cap$是特化的生物航母。他们用舰载机的潮水淹没战场。
entries.en: $harbinger_class_plural_cap$ are specialized biological carriers. They swarm the battlefield with plagues of strike-craft.

entries.zh: $stinger_class_plural_cap$是重型生物炮舰。他们身披厚厚的几丁质铠甲，是令人生畏的哨卫。
entries.en: $stinger_class_plural_cap$ are heavy long-range biological ships. Wrapped in thick chitinous plating, they are grim sentinels of destruction.

entries.zh: 生物工程的突破使我们可以培养出具有军事用途的超光速太空飞行器。
entries.en: Breakthroughs in bio-engineering have allowed the growth of space-faring, FTL-capable craft with military applications.

entries.zh: §H$mauler_stage_1$§!\n$mauler_class_cap$是最基础的军用生物舰船，装有短射程武器和厚重大的甲壳装甲。
entries.en: §H$mauler_stage_1$§!\nThe $mauler_class_cap$ is the most basic military ship, armed with close range weapons and thick carapace armor.

entries.zh: 这些孵化舱加速了营养丰富的生物舱内战舰胚胎的孕育过程。虽然简陋，但它们标志着一支舰队迈向并非建造、而是生长的第一步。
entries.en: These incubation chambers accelerate the gestation of embryonic warships within nutrient-dense biopods. Though rudimentary, they mark the first step toward a fleet that is not constructed, but grown.

entries.zh: 精进的孵化流程缩短了有机星舰的成熟时间，并提升了其结构完整性。强化的养分输送系统和基因调优确保了舰船的迅捷性和坚韧性。
entries.en: Refined incubation processes reduce maturation times and improve structural integrity of organic starships. Enhanced nutrient delivery systems and genetic tuning ensure the vessels are both swift and resilient.

entries.zh: §H$mauler_stage_2$§!\n对$ship_growth_stage_2$$mauler_class_cap$进行选育以提供更强大的火力和装甲。
entries.en: §H$mauler_stage_2$§!\nA $ship_growth_stage_2$ $mauler_class_cap$ has been selectively grown to support greater firepower and armor.

entries.zh: §H生物舰船之道§!\n§E科技可允许进一步发展更强大的生物舰船。§!
entries.en: §HBiological Ship Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in more powerful biological ships.§!

entries.zh: 这些设施能够制造出具有无与伦比生命力和适应能力的舰船。优化的基因矩阵和先进的生物技术支持确保了在太空中无与伦比的性能。
entries.en: These facilities yield vessels of unparalleled vitality and adaptive capacity. Optimized genetic matrices and advanced biotechnological support guarantee unmatched performance in the void.

entries.zh: §H$mauler_stage_3$§!\n$ship_growth_stage_3$$mauler_class_cap$是$mauler_class_cap$的巅峰，用无数的短射程武器武装到牙齿。
entries.en: §H$mauler_stage_3$§!\nAn $ship_growth_stage_3$ $mauler_class_cap$ is the pinnacle of $mauler_class_cap$, highly armored and with a large number of close-range weapons.

entries.zh: 在早期生物工程的基础上，织蛛被设计为在敏捷性与增强的战斗能力之间取得平衡。
entries.en: Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities.

entries.zh: §H$weaver_stage_1$§!\n$weaver_class_cap$是一种灵活的中型生物战舰，其设计目的是通过机动能力应对大型敌方目标，支援舰队战斗。
entries.en: §H$weaver_stage_1$§!\nThe $weaver_class_cap$ is a versatile mid-sized bioship, designed to outmaneuver larger foes and support fleet engagements.

entries.zh: 这些设施在精密的生物舱内培育中型生物飞船，利用强化的养分输送和基因优化，为舰队生产灵活且适应性强的舰船。
entries.en: These facilities nurture mid-sized biological ships within refined biopods, employing enhanced nutrient delivery and genetic optimization to produce agile and adaptable vessels for the fleet.

entries.zh: 这些设施采用先进的生物工程技术，以加速生长周期并增强舰船的适应性。改进的基因矩阵和优化的环境确保这些生物舰船既坚固耐用，又在战斗中具有高度的反应能力。
entries.en: These facilities employ enhanced bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth cycles and enhance vessel adaptability. Improved genetic matrices and optimized environments ensure these biological ships are both durable and highly responsive in combat.

entries.zh: §H$weaver_stage_2$§!\n对$ship_growth_stage_2$$weaver_class_cap$进行选育已提高机动能力，增强舰队行动的适应能力。
entries.en: §H$weaver_stage_2$§!\nA $ship_growth_stage_2$ $weaver_class_cap$ has been selectively grown to enhance mobility and adaptability in fleet operations.

entries.zh: 这些设施生产的生物飞船拥有无与伦比的精确性和多功能性。革命性的生长技术和适应性基因强化造就了能够在最严苛的战术环境中蓬勃发展的舰船。
entries.en: These facilities produce biological ships of unparalleled precision and versatility. Revolutionary growth techniques and adaptive genetic enhancements result in vessels that thrive in even the most demanding tactical scenarios.

entries.zh: §H$weaver_stage_3$§!\n对$ship_growth_stage_3$$weaver_class_cap$进行针对性的选育，以获取更进一步的敏捷性，提升战术的多变能力。
entries.en: §H$weaver_stage_3$§!\nAn $ship_growth_stage_3$ $weaver_class_cap$ has been meticulously grown for superior agility and tactical versatility.

entries.zh: 孵后代表着生物工程战争的重大飞跃，将强大的火力与活体技术的韧性融为一体。这些舰船构成了舰队的核心力量。
entries.en: Harbingers represent a significant leap in bio-engineered warfare, blending formidable firepower with the resilience of living technology. These ships serve as the backbone of the fleet.

entries.zh: §H$harbinger_stage_1$§!\n$harbinger_class_cap$通过生育舰载机群拱卫整支舰队。
entries.en: §H$harbinger_stage_1$§!\nThe $harbinger_class_cap$ bolsters the fleet by spawning strike craft.

entries.zh: 这些设施培育大型生物飞船，通过先进的营养灌注技术为其提供养分，以确保其韧性和战斗准备状态。
entries.en: These facilities nurture large biological ships, feeding them through advanced nutrient infusion to ensure resilience and combat readiness.

entries.zh: 精良的设施采用先进的生物工程技术，以加速生长并增强结构完整性。由此产生的舰船具备更高的耐久性和提升的作战效率。
entries.en: Refined facilities employ sophisticated bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth and enhance structural integrity. The resulting vessels feature improved endurance and increased combat efficiency.

entries.zh: §H$harbinger_stage_2$§!\n增强的生长技术能够产出更加强壮、更加可靠的舰船。
entries.en: §H$harbinger_stage_2$§!\nEnhanced growth techniques yield stronger and more reliable vessels.

entries.zh: 先进的孵化系统能够生产出具有卓越耐久性和火力的生物战舰。通过基因微调和优越的生长环境，这些战舰拥有无与伦比的韧性，足以在战场上占据主导地位。
entries.en: Advanced incubation systems produce biological ships of exceptional durability and firepower. Genetic fine-tuning and superior growth environments create vessels capable of dominating the battlefield with unmatched resilience.

entries.zh: §H$harbinger_stage_3$§!\n为追求极致力量和战场优势而培育。
entries.en: §H$harbinger_stage_3$§!\nGrown for maximum strength and battlefield superiority.

entries.zh: 刺蜂旨在对高价值目标实施毁灭性打击，擅长利用敌方防御的弱点。
entries.en: Stingers are designed to deliver devastating strikes against high-value targets. They excel in exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses.

entries.zh: §H$stinger_stage_1$§!\n迅捷致命的生物飞船，为精确打击和战术优势而生。
entries.en: §H$stinger_stage_1$§!\nA swift and deadly bioship, bred for precision strikes and tactical superiority."

entries.zh: 这些设施培育出流线型的敏捷生物飞船，专为精准和速度而设计。通过采用先进的生物舱和专用营养液，它们生产出能够进行精确高效打击的舰船。
entries.en: These facilities grow sleek, agile biological ships designed for precision and speed. Employing advanced biopods and specialized nutrient solutions, they produce vessels capable of precise and efficient strikes.

entries.zh: 精良的设施加速了增长周期，并提高了生物工程精度，从而打造出具有卓越机动性和精准度的舰船。这些提升使刺蜂在战术对抗中成为一股毁灭性的力量。
entries.en: Refined facilities accelerate growth cycles and improve bio-engineered precision, resulting in vessels with superior maneuverability and accuracy. These enhancements make the Stinger a devastating force in tactical engagements.

entries.zh: §H$stinger_stage_2$§!\n为战术行动提供更快的速度和更高的精准度。
entries.en: §H$stinger_stage_2$§!\nRefined for greater speed and precision in tactical operations.

entries.zh: 生物飞船生长技术的巅峰之作，这些先进设施能够生产出速度和杀伤力无与伦比的刺蜂。优化的基因模板和尖端的孵化技术确保了这些飞船以迅捷而致命的精准度主宰任何战场。
entries.en: The apex of bioship growth technology, these advanced facilities produce Stingers of unmatched speed and lethality. Optimized genetic templates and cutting-edge incubation techniques ensure these ships dominate any battlefield with swift and deadly precision.

entries.zh: §H$stinger_stage_3$§!\n为极致速度、精准度和战场统治力而生。
entries.en: §H$stinger_stage_3$§!\nGrown for ultimate speed, precision, and battlefield dominance.

entries.zh: 该生物舰船没有附加器官。
entries.en: This biological ship has no supplementary organs.

entries.zh: 这些辅助器官通过生长或移植进入活体舰船，设计用于各种独特能力的精细调控。
entries.en: Grown or grafted into living hulls, these supplementary organs are designed to fine-tune the unique capabilities of biological ships.

entries.zh: 植入腺体分泌一种强力的激素类固醇混合物，促使该舰船发育到下一个生长阶段。
entries.en: Implanted glands secrete a potent mix of hormones and steroids, forcing this ship to advance to the next stage of growth.

entries.zh: 该器官将异星天然气加入其荷尔蒙和类固醇分泌过程，能够加速生物飞船的生长速度。
entries.en: By infusing exotic gases into its hormonal and steroid-rich secretions, this organ accelerates the growth of biological ships.

entries.zh: 将舰船推进器官产生的化学废弃物进行循环利用可以提升耐久力。
entries.en: Recycling the waste chemicals produced by the ship's motor organs allows for increased stamina.

entries.zh: 舰船的在循环通路中添加易爆微粒可以进一步提升耐久力。
entries.en: The addition of volatile motes in the recycling pathways of the ship provide further increases in stamina.

entries.zh: 植入的腺体调整了我们$mauler_class_plural_cap$体液的化学组成，使其具有腐蚀性并增强其潜在的破坏力。
entries.en: Implanted glands modify the bodily fluids of our $mauler_class_plural_cap$, rendering them corrosive and enhancing their destructive potential.

entries.zh: 将异星天然气添加进我们$mauler_class_plural_cap$的体液中可以进一步提升其造成伤害的能力，对敌方舰船的装甲更为有效。
entries.en: The incorporation of exotic gases into the fluids of our $mauler_class_plural_cap$ further increases the damage they deal, in particular towards the armor of enemy ships.

entries.zh: 织蛛会释放出复杂的生化信号，加速附近有机体的成熟。这些发育信息素能提高生长速度和适应能力，确保舰队迅速进化以应对任何挑战。
entries.en: Weavers exude a complex array of biochemical signals that accelerate the maturation of nearby organic entities. These developmental pheromones enhance growth rate and adaptation, ensuring the fleet evolves rapidly to meet any challenge.

entries.zh: 精密的生物工程技术增强了这些信息素的效力，显著加速了友军生物舰船的生长和优化。这种升级后的光环确保舰队以惊人的速度达到最佳性能，即使在激烈的战斗中也能如此。
entries.en: Refined bio-engineering amplifies the potency of these pheromones, dramatically accelerating the growth and optimization of allied biological ships. This upgraded aura ensures the fleet reaches peak performance with remarkable speed, even in the heat of battle.

entries.zh: §P该光环只对可生长的生物舰船生效。§!
entries.en: §PThis Aura only applies to Biological Ships capable of Growth.§!

entries.zh: 这种有机装置增强了生物舰船之间的联系，提升了整个舰队的能量传输与协调能力。它的存在确保了战斗和资源管理效率的显著提升。
entries.en: This organic device strengthens the bond between biological ships, enhancing energy transfer and coordination across the fleet. Its presence ensures improved efficiency in combat and resource management.

entries.zh: 作为共生放大器的更高级迭代版本，该设备能够根据舰队需求动态调整，从而提高效率和响应速度。它优化了舰队整体性能，确保作战期间的无缝适应性。
entries.en: A more advanced iteration of the symbiotic amplifier, this device dynamically adjusts to fleet needs, providing increased efficiency and responsiveness. It optimizes fleet-wide capabilities, ensuring seamless adaptability during operations.

entries.zh: 这种细胞基质围绕孵化中的舰载机卵生长，起到生物工程孵化器的作用。
entries.en: This cellular matrix forms around the eggs of maturing strike craft, acting as a bio-engineered incubator.

entries.zh: 该舰船的舰载机在孵化周期中暴露在异星天然气中，可以快速成熟。
entries.en: Exposure to exotic gases during the incubation period leads to a rapid maturation of this ship's strike craft.

entries.zh: 该舰船的机库内分泌可以刺激发育阶段舰载机的几丁质生长响应，增强其耐受力。
entries.en: Secretions within the hangar bays stimulate chitin growth in developing strike craft, reinforcing their durability.

entries.zh: 在我们舰载机的几丁质外骨骼中植入稀有水晶可以进一步提升其抵御伤害的能力。
entries.en: Seeding the chitin exoskeletons of our strike craft with rare crystals provides even greater resistance to damage.

entries.zh: 一组专门用于处理传感器数据的次级神经丛。
entries.en: A secondary neural cluster dedicated to processing sensory data.

entries.zh: 在神经鞘中植入稀有水晶可以提高目标处理能力。
entries.en: Rare crystals embedded in the sheaths of neural pathways allow for greater target processing capabilities.

entries.zh: 在该舰船的胸腔生长的一列散热气门可以向太空中排出高浓度的高温废气，提升其武器的射速。
entries.en: A series of heat exhausts along the thorax of this ship allow it to vent compressed, high-temperature gases into space, improving the fire rate of its weapons.

entries.zh: 使用易爆微粒作为热交换介质需要特定的细胞基质以避免意外的爆炸。
entries.en: Use of volatile motes as a heat exchange medium requires a dedicated cellular matrix to prevent any unintended explosions.

entries.zh: 这种先进的生物装甲将坚韧的有机组织与纳米结构材料相结合，形成了一种能够抵御极端冲击的活体外壳。该外壳能够动态适应损伤，迅速再生，为生物飞船提供无与伦比的防护。
entries.en: This advanced bio-armor integrates resilient organic tissues with nanostructured materials, creating a living carapace capable of withstanding extreme impacts. The carapace dynamically adapts to damage, regenerating swiftly and providing unparalleled protection for biological ships.

entries.zh: 强化几丁质与陶瓷化合物融合，赋予这种生物装甲卓越的耐久性和耐热性。其分层结构提供了坚固的防护，同时保持了有机体所需的灵活性。
entries.en: Reinforced chitin infused with ceramic compounds grants this bio-armor exceptional durability and heat resistance. Its layered structure offers robust protection while retaining the flexibility needed for organic vessels.

entries.zh: 这种生物装甲结合了坚韧的有机组织与塑钢加固材料，在强度和灵活性之间实现了卓越的平衡。这种混合结构能够提供对动能和能量攻击的出色防护，使其成为生物飞船的可靠选择。
entries.en: This bio-armor combines resilient organic tissues with plasteel reinforcements, offering a remarkable balance of strength and flexibility. The hybrid structure provides superior protection against both kinetic and energy-based attacks, making it a reliable choice for biological ships.

entries.zh: 这种生物装甲注入了耐用的有机化合物，能有效抵抗持续性伤害。其混合结构确保了卓越的耐久性，同时又不影响生物载具的灵活性。
entries.en: Infused with durable organic compounds, this bio-armor provides exceptional resistance to sustained damage. Its hybrid structure ensures remarkable endurance without compromising the flexibility of living vessels.

entries.zh: 这种甲壳是一种生物工程的奇迹，它将零素细丝融入有机组织中，形成了近乎坚不可摧的装甲。这种致密而适应性强的构成，即使面对最具破坏性的力量，也能提供无可匹敌的保护。
entries.en: A marvel of bio-engineering, this carapace incorporates neutronium filaments within organic tissue, resulting in near-impervious armor. The dense yet adaptable composition offers unparalleled protection against even the most destructive forces.

entries.zh: 生物装甲进化的巅峰之作，此甲壳的设计灵感源自远古时代的顶级掠食者。其层叠结构结合了可再生的有机物质和近乎坚不可摧的生物合金，创造出一种如启发它的生物一般凶猛且坚韧的防御。
entries.en: The pinnacle of bio-armor evolution, this carapace is inspired by ancient, apex predators. Its layered structure combines regenerative organic matter with nearly indestructible bio-alloys, creating a defense as fierce and unyielding as the creatures that inspired it.

entries.zh: 利用磁能脉冲和场投射原理，甲壳内的这种离子化层可以生成反应装药，分散碰撞的能量。
entries.en: Ionized layers within the carapace generate a reactive charge, dispersing impact energy through magnetic repulsion and projected fields.

entries.zh: 特化的肌肉组织产生能量场，形成保护性偏转护盾。尽管只能吸收很有限的伤害，但可以快速再生。
entries.en: Specialized muscle tissue generates an energy field, forming a protective deflector shield. Although they can only absorb a limited amount of punishment, they are capable of rapid regeneration.

entries.zh: 精炼的肌肉组织能更有效地引导能量，从而强化偏导护盾。这些增强的系统能吸收更多伤害并更快地充能，在持久战中提供更强的防护能力。
entries.en: Refined muscle tissue channels energy more efficiently, strengthening deflector shields. These enhanced systems absorb more damage and recharge faster, offering greater protection in prolonged combat.

entries.zh: 这种先进的生物护盾技术整合了强化的、能量传导组织，具备更强的防护能力。它能有效抵御能量攻击和动能攻击，确保生物舰船在各种战斗环境中都能进行灵活防御。
entries.en: This advanced bio-shielding technology integrates reinforced, energy-conducting tissues with enhanced protective capabilities. It offers strong resistance against both energy and kinetic attacks, ensuring adaptable defense for biological ships in various combat situations.

entries.zh: 生物护盾技术的巅峰之作，这种强化肌肉组织能更高效地传导能量，增强护盾强度。它为能量和动能攻击提供了强有力的保护，确保在战斗中具备多方位防御能力。
entries.en: The pinnacle of bio-shield technology, this reinforced musculature conducts energy more effectively, enhancing shield strength. It offers robust protection against both energy and kinetic attacks, ensuring versatile defense in combat.

entries.zh: 超适应性组织能够引导巨大的能量流，形成近乎坚不可摧的防御。这种先进的系统能够快速再生，即使在无情的攻击下也能保护生物飞船。
entries.en: Hyper-adaptive tissues channel immense energy flows, creating an almost impenetrable defense. This advanced system regenerates rapidly, keeping the bioship protected even under relentless assault.

entries.zh: 这种尖端生物护盾技术将暗物质融入有机组织，显著提升了能量传导和防御能力。这种特殊物质的注入使肌肉能够生成登峰造极的护盾，能够承受超乎寻常的打击。
entries.en: This cutting-edge bio-shielding integrates dark matter into organic tissues, dramatically enhancing energy conductivity and defensive capabilities. The infusion of this exotic substance enables the musculature to generate shields of unparalleled strength, capable of withstanding extraordinary levels of punishment.

entries.zh: 这种先进肌肉组织融合了具有心灵感应活性的物质泽珞，能够以无与伦比的精确度和适应性生成护盾。其独特特性增强了生物护盾的韧性和再生能力，提供了近乎超自然的防御水平。
entries.en: Infused with the psionically reactive substance Zro, this advanced musculature generates shields with unparalleled precision and adaptability. Its unique properties enhance both the resilience and regenerative capabilities of the bio-shield, providing an almost preternatural level of defense.

entries.zh: 这种非凡的生物护盾通过特殊培育的组织驾驭灵能能量，创造出能够以不可思议的精确度适应来袭威胁的防御系统。其共振效应增强了护盾强度并加速了再生能力，使其成为抵御最不可预测攻击的强大保障。
entries.en: This extraordinary bio-shielding harnesses psionic energy through specially cultivated tissues, creating defenses that adapt to incoming threats with uncanny precision. The resonance amplifies shield strength and accelerates regeneration, making it a potent safeguard against even the most unpredictable attacks.

entries.zh: 将护盾投射组织培植在远古文物结节上，该科技可以创造延留力场，在着弹瞬间将时间流速减缓。这一延缓增强了护盾消耗来袭攻击能量的能力，显著提升了防御韧性。
entries.en: By cultivating shield-projection tissues around ancient artifact nodules, this technology generates suspension fields that slow time at the point of impact. This delay enhances the shield's ability to dissipate energy from incoming attacks, significantly improving defensive resilience.

entries.zh: 通过适当的生物工程改造，消化道可以充当生物核反应堆，实现基于诱发裂变的新陈代谢方式产生能量，但会产生有害的核废料。
entries.en: With proper bio-engineering, a digestive tract can act as a biological nuclear reactor allowing for a metabolism based on induced fission, producing both power and harmful nuclear waste

entries.zh: 通过将具有核聚变能力的微生物群整合进舰船肠道的生态系统中，使其能在产生巨大能量的同时避免许多与裂变能源有关的危害。
entries.en: By integrating microfauna capable of nuclear fusion into the biome of a bioship's gut, this system generates immense power while avoiding many of the hazards associated with fission-based energy sources.

entries.zh: 一层神秘的物质物质涂覆在我们生物舰船的消化道上，能直接从暗物质中提取能量，这种现象看起来违背了已知的物理定律。
entries.en: A mysterious substance coats the digestive tract of our biological ships, drawing energy directly from dark matter in an apparent violation of known physical laws.

entries.zh: 这些感知器官利用类似雷达的生物机制在深空中发挥作用，使飞船具备一种基础的探测和追踪能力。
entries.en: These sensory organs make use of a biological equivalent of RADAR to function in deep space, allowing ships to have basic detection and tracking capabilities.

entries.zh: 这些感受器官用于探测空间中由飞船的存在而引起的重力变化。
entries.en: These sensory organs have been developed to detect gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

entries.zh: 一种可探测到飞船航行时产生的亚空间尾迹的感受器官。其灵敏度和作用距离远超此前发展的深空感受器官。
entries.en: Sensory organs that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range far exceeds any previous sensory organ developed for deep space.

entries.zh: 利用旋转的快子束来探测极远距离星际运动的感受器官。
entries.en: Sensory organs that make use of rotating tachyon beams to detect interstellar movement at extreme distances.

entries.zh: 通过持续推动超空间来让舰船钻过星际超空间航道的狭小通道。
entries.en: Constantly pushing against hyperspace allows for a ship to squeeze through the tight passages of interstellar hyperlanes.

entries.zh: 跃迁奇观在现实织构中撕开舰船大小的裂口，实现近乎瞬时的跨星系移动。其间舰船所跨过的空间的本质我们仍然所知甚少。
entries.en: The Jump Organ cleaves ship-sized holes in the very fabric of reality, allowing for near-instantaneous movement between systems. The nature of the space the ship passes through on this journey is still poorly understood.

entries.zh: 灵能跃迁器官能够聚焦飞船与船员的灵能潜力，从而扭曲局部时空连续体，消除起始点与目标地点之间的距离——至少理论上是这样的。
entries.en: The Psi Jump Organ acts as a focus point for the the psionic potential of the ship and crew to warp the local space-time continuum, eliminating the distance between the point of origin and the destination. Supposedly.

entries.zh: 就像蜘蛛网上的丝线一样，多维空间的其他维度在大多数恒星的重力井之间运动。在这些超空间航道间理论上是可以进行超光速旅行的。
entries.en: Like the strands of a spider web, the extra-dimensional realm of hyperspace runs between the gravity wells of most stars. Faster than light travel is theoretically possible along these hyperlanes.

entries.zh: 我们已经证实，在太空中存在着特殊的“突破点”，通过这些点可以让航天器以最小的能耗进入超空间航道。这一发现将为新一代超级引擎的研发铺平道路。
entries.en: We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.

entries.zh: 新一代超级引擎能够利用的亚空间滑流，这一突破性技术使其性能获得了显著提升。
entries.en: A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing subspace slipstreams. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.

entries.zh: 革命性的$BIO_JUMP_DRIVE_1$可以在量子水平操控局部时空连续性，并重组至与目标地点完全相同的状态，于是这艘舰船基几乎在一瞬间完成了星系间的“跃迁”。
entries.en: The revolutionary $BIO_JUMP_DRIVE_1$ manipulates the local space-time continuum at the quantum level, restructuring it to match the target destination. This process enables ships to appear to "jump" near-instantaneously between systems.

entries.zh: 这艘飞船通过肌肉组织、鳍状结构与化学推进器的协同运作，实现了亚光速航行能力。
entries.en: Through a combination of muscles, fins, and chemical exhausts this ship is capable of sublight travel.

entries.zh: 由多个带电器官组成的推进系统能够加速离子流，从而产生强劲的推进动力。
entries.en: An array of electrically charged organs accelerate ions to generate thrust.

entries.zh: 推进器官电力系统经过全面升级后，在亚光速航行状态下不仅能达到更高的速度，还能实现更灵活的机动操控。
entries.en: Further refinements of the electrical capabilities of the motor organs allow for greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

entries.zh: 先进的聚变舱室为这艘飞船提供强大动力，使其在亚光速航行时具备无与伦比的机动性能和速度优势。
entries.en: Highly advanced fusion chambers grant this ship unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

entries.zh: 在舰船的组织内嵌入暗物质使其可以在空间之间“游动”，通过违背常规物理定律和目前对推进的理解的方式进行移动。
entries.en: Embedded clusters of dark matter within the ship's tissues enable it to "swim" through space, moving in ways that defy conventional physics and our current understanding of propulsion.

entries.zh: 所有生物舰船都具备基本的战斗本能，能够进行规避机动和目标计算。
entries.en: All biological ships have rudimentary combat instincts, capable of evasive maneuvers and targeting calculations.

entries.zh: 这些植入体直接与飞船的有机系统集成，能够实现快速决策和精确的战术协调。它们作为活体战斗计算机运行，增强了态势感知能力，并优化了战场表现。
entries.en: These implants integrate directly with a ship's organic systems, enabling rapid decision-making and precise tactical coordination. Functioning as a living combat computer, they enhance situational awareness and optimize battlefield performance.

entries.zh: 作为标准神经植入体的进化版本，这些系统提升了战术处理能力和决策速度。它们提供了更高的效率和协调性，使生物舰船能够迅速应对不断变化的战场条件。
entries.en: An evolution of standard neural implants, these systems enhance tactical processing and decision-making speed. They provide greater efficiency and coordination, allowing biological ships to respond swiftly to changing battlefield conditions.

entries.zh: 这些植入体承载着可以进行独立策略思考的智慧型生物智能。将有机直觉和人工理解结合，可以使生物舰船机动灵活地适应复杂的战斗场景，展现出接近全自动的决策能力。
entries.en: These implants house bio-sapient intelligence capable of independent strategic thought. By blending organic instinct with artificial reasoning, they enable biological ships to adapt dynamically to complex combat scenarios, exhibiting near-autonomous decision-making.

entries.zh: 这些系统完全自助运行。这些舰船内置的具有自我意识的生物智能使其可以在无需外部输入的情况下进行分析、策划并执行决策，实现前所未有的战斗效率。
entries.en: These systems operate with complete autonomy. Infused with self-aware bio-intelligence, they grant ships the ability to analyze, strategize, and execute decisions without external input, achieving unparalleled combat efficiency.

entries.zh: 这些植入体利用灵能的力量为舰船提供潜意识直觉，使其可以在敌人行动发生之前就加以预知。这种近超自然能力让舰队拥有很大的决策空间，在最复杂的威胁面前也能做出近乎瞬间的反应。
entries.en: Harnessing the power of psionics, these implants provide biological ships with precognitive insight, allowing them to anticipate enemy actions before they occur. This near-supernatural capability gives fleets a decisive edge, enabling split-second reactions to even the most complex threats.

entries.zh: 建造生长舱可以在舰队内对生物舰船进行有机培养。
entries.en: The construction of Growth Chambers enables the organic cultivation of biological ships within the fleet.

entries.zh: 增强生长舱的效率和能力可以通过优化肌体设计来加速生物舰船的培育。
entries.en: The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.

entries.zh: 允许在方舟恒星基地上建造§Y$arkship_growth_chamber$§!，为星系内的生物舰船提供生长加速光环。
entries.en: Enables construction of §Y$arkship_growth_chamber$§! on Arkship starbases, providing a system-wide aura that accelerates bioship growth.

entries.zh: 强壮的颚，可以用恐怖的效率咬穿敌舰装甲、撕碎船体。
entries.en: Powerful mandibles, capable of rending armor and tearing through the hulls of enemy vessels with brutal efficiency.

entries.zh: 这些极具破坏力的附肢整合了层状有机结构以提高耐用度和剪切力，可以咬穿最强韧的防御。
entries.en: These devastating appendages incorporate layered organic structures to enhance durability and cutting power, shredding even the toughest defenses.

entries.zh: 这些颚无与伦比地锋利强韧，可以准确无误地切穿先进的合金。
entries.en: These mandibles possess unparalleled sharpness and resilience, capable of slicing through advanced alloys with unnerving precision.

entries.zh: 发射高能等离子流的武器，虽然能分解装甲，但射程极短。
entries.en: Weapons that emit streams of high-energy plasma at targets. Though capable of disintegrating armor, they have an incredibly short range.

entries.zh: 更锋利的刚毛、更快的射速，布下毁灭性的弹幕摧垮护盾、撕毁船体。
entries.en: Sharper quills, fired at increased rates, deliver devastating volleys to overwhelm shields and shred hulls.

entries.zh: 优化的生物刚毛以极快的初速射出，可以穿透最强大的防御。
entries.en: Refined biological quills fire with superior velocity to pierce through even hardened defenses.

entries.zh: 以极高频率发射的超高密度刚毛可以瞬间击溃护盾，轻易凿穿重装甲目标。
entries.en: Hyper-dense quills can be fired at a blistering pace eviscerating shields and carving through heavily armored targets with ease.

entries.zh: 刚毛武器的巅峰是能以无情而致命的精确制导弹药淹没战场。
entries.en: The pinnacle of quill weaponry is capable of saturating battlefields with relentless and devastating precision-guided projectiles.

entries.zh: 这些光谱仪作为光学腔体，能够发射高强度的红色激光束。
entries.en: These scales act as optical cavities, capable of emitting high-intensity red laser beams.

entries.zh: 生物激光器进一步改进后的蓝色版本发射波长更短，能够造成更大的损伤。
entries.en: Further refinements on biological lasing devices, these blue variants emit shorter wavelengths, capable of greater damage.

entries.zh: 这是一种基于采矿无人机切割光束的生物学武器，能够轻松切穿厚实的甲壳。
entries.en: A biological implementation on the cutting beams found on Mining Drones, this weapon can easily cut through thick carapace.

entries.zh: 这些器官结合特殊的外壳结构与肌肉的快速收缩，以先进的声致发光技术产生定向能量脉冲。这些脉冲射速快、能量高，非常适合用于对抗舰载机和导弹。
entries.en: These organs use specialized shell structures in combination with fast-twitch muscles to produce directed energy pulses using an advanced form of sonoluminescence. The rapid fire and intensity of these pulses make them ideally suited for countermeasures against strike craft and missiles.

entries.zh: 点防御器官中次级神经丛的形成可以进一步提高目标追踪能力和威胁拦截率。
entries.en: The formation of a secondary neural cluster located within the point defense organ allows for further improved target tracking and an increased rate of threat interception.

entries.zh: 这些巨型舰炮主宰了飞船的生物学构造，对机动性和瞄准能力造成显著削弱。然而，此类武器纯粹的毁灭性威力足以弥补这些缺陷。
entries.en: These enormous cannons dominate the ship's biology, causing significant impairments to movement and targeting. However, the sheer destructive power of such weapons more than compensates for these drawbacks.

entries.zh: 这个笨重的器官能够形成致密的几丁质棒，并以高速从远距离发射出去。
entries.en: This unwieldy organ grants the ability to form dense chitinous rods and launch them at high velocity from long range.

entries.zh: 该器官产生高浓度质子作为弹丸。然而其充能过程较为漫长。
entries.en: This organ creates tight concentrations of protons as a powerful projectile. However, the charging process can be quite lengthy.

entries.zh: 向友军舰船发射治愈性孢子，修复微小的船体损伤，在激烈的战场中增强韧性。
entries.en: Restorative spores are fired at allied ships, mending minor hull damage and supporting resilience in the heat of battle.

entries.zh: 强化再生外分泌可以释放强力治疗化合物在强大火力下支援友军。
entries.en: Enhanced restorative outputs deliver potent healing compounds to sustain allied ships under heavy fire.

entries.zh: 靶向释放高度适应性生物质可以修复显著损伤、促进器官再生。
entries.en: Targeted bursts of highly adaptive biomatter repair significant damage while bolstering organic regeneration.

entries.zh: 智能治疗体释放后可以主动寻的，修复致命损伤，大幅提高战场上的生存率。
entries.en: Intelligent healing agents are dispatched, capable of seeking out and repairing critical damage points, drastically improving the chances of surviving in battle.

entries.zh: 该生物支援武器能进行近乎瞬间修复再生，在最激烈的交火中确保友军存活。
entries.en: This biological support weaponry is capable of near-instantaneous repairs and regeneration, ensuring allies endure even the fiercest engagements.

entries.zh: 发射的再生荚可以为友军舰船送去强力治疗化合物。
entries.en: Regenerative pods are launched to deliver strong healing compounds to allied ships.

entries.zh: 释放的高效再生荚中装有治愈性生物质，可以快速修复复数舰船的损伤。
entries.en: Highly efficient pods imbued with healing biomatter are deployed to rapidly repair damage across multiple vessels.

entries.zh: 发射含有修复试剂的荚仓，基于损伤的严重性优化治疗过程，确保不会留下薄弱点。
entries.en: Pods containing repair agents are launched, optimizing healing based on the severity of damage and ensuring no vulnerabilities remain.

entries.zh: 用适应性孢子淹没战场的荚仓，为射程内的友军舰船提供智能修复。
entries.en: Pods that saturate the battlefield with adaptive spores provide smart healing to all allied vessels within range.

entries.zh: 部署的荚仓可以释放出智能微器官的浪潮，受损再严重的舰队都能够复活。
entries.en: Deploys pods that unleash a wave of intelligent microorganisms, capable of revitalizing even the most damaged fleets.

entries.zh: 发射装有可塑性细胞的荚舱，触发新船体组织的生长，将有机舰船的耐久性推升至前所未有的极限。
entries.en: Pods filled with malleable cells are launched to trigger the growth of new hull tissues, pushing the endurance of organic vessels beyond their former limits.

entries.zh: 有机抑制触须会释放不稳定脉冲，干扰敌方护盾并削弱其防御能力。
entries.en: Organic suppressor tendrils emit destabilizing pulses, disrupting enemy shields and weakening their defenses.

entries.zh: 精密的压制系统能够放大干扰场，有效削弱护盾强度，降低敌方舰船的防御能力。
entries.en: Refined suppressor systems amplify disruption fields, effectively draining shield integrity and reducing the resilience of opposing vessels.

entries.zh: 强大的触须投射出广域压制场，通过扰乱敌方舰船的护盾和通讯系统，削弱整个敌方编队的战斗力。
entries.en: Powerful tendrils project wide-area suppression fields, crippling entire formations of enemy vessels by disrupting both shields and communications.

entries.zh: 自适应生物电脉冲削弱护盾并扰乱瞄准系统，使敌人变得脆弱且失去方向感。
entries.en: Adaptive bioelectric pulses weaken shields and destabilize targeting systems, leaving enemies vulnerable and disoriented.

entries.zh: 复杂的生物等离子波能在极远距离上使护盾失效并瘫痪系统，令敌人束手无策。
entries.en: Complex bio-plasma waves nullify shields and paralyze systems across vast distances, rendering foes helpless.

entries.zh: 一定几率使军用舰船['concept_confusion', 陷入困惑]，持续£time£ §Y5-10§!天。该几率取决于目标舰船体积。
entries.en: Chance to ['concept_confusion', Confuse] Military Ships for £time£ §Y5-10§! Days. The chance is based on Target Ship Size.

entries.zh: 迷航的舰船会失去区分友军和敌军的能力，导致它们不分青红皂白地攻击。
entries.en: Confused ships lose the ability to differentiate between allies and enemies, causing them to attack indiscriminately.

entries.zh: 注入不稳定酶的有机弹丸会扰乱敌人的目标系统，降低其精确度。
entries.en: Organic projectiles imbued with destabilizing enzymes scramble enemy targeting systems and reduce their accuracy.

entries.zh: 精炼的生物化合物扰乱敌方目标锁定系统和短程通讯，在敌军中散播混乱。
entries.en: Refined biological compounds disrupt targeting systems and short-range communications, sowing chaos among enemy ranks.

entries.zh: 自适应生物弹药被部署，专门针对有机或义体人船员的神经弱点，从而削弱敌人的效率。
entries.en: Adaptive bio-munitions are deployed to exploit neural weaknesses in both organic and synthetic crews, crippling enemy efficiency.

entries.zh: 智能生物弹丸在撞击时会释放干扰场，扰乱敌方目标系统并导致大范围故障。
entries.en: Intelligent bio-projectiles emit disruptive fields on impact, scrambling enemy targeting systems and causing widespread malfunctions.

entries.zh: 先进的生物武器会在敌方系统中产生级联反馈回路，使其攻击效果大打折扣。
entries.en: Advanced biological ordnance creates a cascading feedback loop within enemy systems, rendering their attacks wildly ineffective.

entries.zh: 生物电磁脉冲使目标锁定系统失效，并使舰队陷入混乱。
entries.en: Bio-electromagnetic pulses incapacitate targeting systems and leave fleets in a state of disarray.

entries.zh: 发射生物强化弹，可有效对抗规避动作，命中灵活目标。
entries.en: Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets.

entries.zh: 发射带有高级追踪酶和自适应飞行路径的精确弹药，提高对快速移动目标的命中率。
entries.en: Fires refined projectiles with superior tracking enzymes and adaptive flight paths, increasing hit rates against fast-moving targets.

entries.zh: 部署可自我导向的生物弹药，锁定移动模式，确保对难以捉摸的敌人进行精确打击。
entries.en: Deploys self-guided bio-munitions that lock onto movement patterns, ensuring accuracy against elusive enemies.

entries.zh: 利用复杂的有机目标锁定系统，能够预测规避动作，即使是最灵活的猎物也难以逃脱。
entries.en: Utilizes complex organic targeting systems that anticipate evasive actions, making even the most agile prey vulnerable.

entries.zh: 发射具备预测追踪能力的智能生物弹药，可突破最精密的规避协议。
entries.en: Fires intelligent bio-projectiles equipped with predictive tracking, overcoming the most sophisticated evasion protocols.

entries.zh: 发射生物等离子弹，可在飞行中调整轨迹，确保命中，即使面对最不稳定的机动也能准确击中。
entries.en: Deploys bio-plasma rounds that adapt mid-flight, guaranteeing hits against even the most erratic maneuvers.

entries.zh: 发射生物弹丸，撞击时释放能量爆发，微妙地增强我们飞船的机动性。
entries.en: Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels.

entries.zh: 释放高浓度生物能量场，进一步提升我方舰船的规避能力。
entries.en: Releases concentrated bio-energetic fields, further boosting the evasion capabilities of our ships.

entries.zh: 发射智能生物弹药，能够自适应地提升敏捷性，即使在最混乱的战斗中也能确保卓越的规避能力。
entries.en: Launches intelligent bio-projectiles that adaptively enhance agility, ensuring superior evasion even in the most chaotic battles.

entries.zh: 部署可生成动态生物电场的先进弹药，显著提升舰船规避敌方火力的能力。
entries.en: Deploys advanced munitions that generate dynamic bio-electric auras, significantly improving the ability of ships to evade enemy fire.

entries.zh: 发射高度先进的弹药，产生大规模的强化场，赋予舰队无与伦比的规避能力。
entries.en: Fires highly advanced projectiles that create large-scale enhancement fields, granting unparalleled evasion to fleets.

entries.zh: 发射可释放自适应能量场的生物弹药，使舰队能够优雅自如地规避伤害。
entries.en: Fires bio-munitions that emit fields of adaptive energy, allowing fleets to dance effortlessly out of harm's way.

entries.zh: 发射有机抛射物，释放特种酶，干扰敌方武器装填系统，并降低其射速。
entries.en: Launches organic projectiles that release specialized enzymes, interfering with enemy weapon reloading systems and reducing their rate of fire.

entries.zh: 增强干扰酶，更有效地干扰装填周期，显著延迟敌方齐射。
entries.en: Enhances disruption enzymes to interfere more effectively with reloading cycles, significantly delaying enemy volleys.

entries.zh: 部署智能生物射弹，瞄准敌方舰队的关键补给系统，从而引发连锁延误效应。
entries.en: Deploys intelligent bio-projectiles that target critical reloading systems, creating cascading delays across enemy fleets.

entries.zh: 利用可自适应生物化合物降解武器装填机制，即使最先进的武器系统，其射击效率也将减半。
entries.en: Utilizes adaptive biological compounds that degrade reloading mechanisms, halving the firing efficiency of even the most advanced weaponry.

entries.zh: 发射可释放压制力场的先进弹药，瘫痪敌方装弹系统，使其陷入极度迟缓的作战状态。
entries.en: Fires advanced munitions that emit suppression fields, crippling enemy reloading systems and rendering them painfully slow.

entries.zh: 释放一种生物脉冲，可在长时间内锁定敌人的重新装弹功能。
entries.en: Releases a biological pulse that locks down enemy reloading for extended periods.

entries.zh: 发射能够释放激励性生物场的有机射弹，可稍微提升武器系统的射速。
entries.en: Fires organic projectiles that emit energizing biofields, subtly increasing the firing speed of weapons systems.

entries.zh: 精制生物弹药可增强生物场强度，进而提升射速。
entries.en: Refined bio-munitions enhance biofield intensity, further accelerating the rate of fire.

entries.zh: 部署自适应生物射弹，可提升反应速度与系统效率，从而实现射速的大幅提高。
entries.en: Deploys adaptive bio-projectiles that amplify reaction times and system efficiency, enabling a significant increase in fire rate.

entries.zh: 生成动态生物电能量场，大幅提升多艘舰船的射击速度，对敌方舰队形成持续压制。
entries.en: Generates dynamic bio-electric auras, vastly enhancing firing speed across multiple vessels, ensuring relentless pressure on enemy fleets.

entries.zh: 释放超能生物弹药，形成大范围强化力场，使舰队能够发动持续高速的密集火力打击。
entries.en: Unleashes hyper-charged bio-munitions that create large-scale enhancement fields, enabling fleets to unleash sustained, rapid-fire barrages.

entries.zh: 释放生物能量波，将我们的武器性能推向巅峰，以毁灭性的火力席卷战场。
entries.en: Projects waves of bio-energy that push our weaponry to their peak performance, flooding the battlefield with devastating firepower.

entries.zh: §E生物舰船积累生物质的速度，使其能够成熟为完全可运转的形态。较高的数值可加速生长过程，确保更快的部署。§!
entries.en: §EThe rate at which biological vessels accrue biomass, enabling their maturation into fully operational forms. A higher value accelerates the growth process, ensuring faster deployment.§!

entries.zh: §E生物舰船从原生阶段过渡到功能成熟期所需积累的生物质总量。较低的阈值能够让准备就绪更快完成。§!
entries.en: §EThe requisite biomass accumulation a biological vessel must achieve to transition from its nascent stage to functional maturity. Lower thresholds allow for quicker readiness.§!

entries.en: No predefined role selected. Customize this ship to your exact specifications

自动生成的设计方案无法被覆盖。如需保存当前设计，请重命名或关闭所有飞船的自动设计功能。
entries.en: Auto-generated designs cannot be overwritten. To save the current design, rename it or disable auto-generated designs for all ships.

entries.en: Bioship is unable to accumulate growth progress

entries.en: Bioship is capable of accumulating growth progress

entries.en: Ship's growth progress is not maxed out
